description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kawarakkulama, Nuwaragam Palatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110186
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4).
